identification: Louis Vuitton large square ring-bound album/sketch book in black Taiga leather (fine diagonal grain, small blind-stamped LV monogram on the lower right of the front cover and an embossed LV mark inside the front board), six gold-tone binder rings, a brown card divider blind-embossed with LV flower motifs, and thick white cream pages with small blind-embossed LV flowers along the bottom edge. Comes in the LV tan card presentation box with 'LOUIS VUITTON MALLETIER A PARIS, MAISON FONDEE EN 1854' printed lid and tissue. The pages in the photos look blank, so 'has been used' may mean a few pages only. Size looks roughly 30 x 30 cm. Probably the Taiga leather 'album' or drawing album sold as an office/desk item. Authenticity not verified; box, divider and embossed refills all look consistent with genuine LV.

viewing_check: Find the heat stamp and date code (often under the rings or in a corner inside the cover: two letters and four digits, made in France or Spain). Check leather edge paint and stitching quality, ring mechanism stamped, and that the refill pages are the LV embossed ones. Measure it. Photograph the box lid, heat stamp and date code for an authentication check before bidding.
